subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a WhatsApp/channel heartbeat recipient contract for OK-only acknowledgments, and if so should it be target, targets, or another shape?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but adding channel heartbeat recipient fields expands public config and needs maintainer-owned semantics for precedence, allowlist validation, and alert preservation.

options.title: Add OK-only recipients
options.body: Implement an additive recipient contract for visible HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments only, with validation and tests for omitted, single, multiple, account override, and invalid-recipient cases.

options.title: Document existing whole-delivery routing
options.body: Keep using agents.defaults/per-agent heartbeat target/to for the whole heartbeat delivery path and document that OK-only admin routing is intentionally unsupported.

options.title: Reject channel-level config growth
options.body: Close the request as out of scope if maintainers decide the extra config surface is not worth the noise reduction.

recommendation.title: Add OK-only recipients
recommendation.body: Implement an additive recipient contract for visible HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments only, with validation and tests for omitted, single, multiple, account override, and invalid-recipient cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent routing/config history and already carried prior review context for this exact product-contract gap.
